ocr_bm25_meta.documentation: Strong lexical baseline: OCR + BM25. BM25 is the right strong lexical control for this corpus: standard-plan queries often carry alphanumeric identifiers (plan IDs, sheet titles, dimension callouts) that a sparse exact-match retriever handles better than a dense encoder. If the visual retriever's margin survives BM25, the margin is not an artifact of having compared only against weak text baselines. Identical protocol to every other ba

visrag_ret.documentation: Strong baseline: VisRAG-Ret (openbmb/VisRAG-Ret). Single-vector dual-stream visual retrieval (MiniCPM-V backbone). Index 1,898 pages, evaluate Recall@5 on the 424-pair test split.

bge_m3_ocr_dense_sparse.documentation: Tuned OCR + BGE-M3 baseline. The manuscript's BGE-M3 baseline encodes each page's full OCR text into a single dense vector (max_length=8192). On dense plan sheets that averages a whole page of scattered callouts into one point, which is the weakest possible use of the model. A *tuned* version is reported so the text-retrieval ceiling is not an artifact of an untuned baseline. Every configuration is reported, not just the best, so the tuning is auditable: full_single the manuscript's setting - one vector per page (reproduction check) chunk_maxpool OCR split

Each diagnosis is stated with the evidence that produced it. CLIP (manuscript: 1.89%) CLIPProcessor resizes every input to 224x224. A 4400x3400 standard-plan sheet becomes 224x224, at which point no dimension callout is legible - the model was being asked to match text against an unreadable thumbnail. The text tower also truncates at 77 tokens. Fix: tile the page, encode each tile at native processor resolution, and score a page by the

ocr_minilm_chunked.documentation: Corrected OCR+MiniLM and VisionRAG-Pyramid baselines. Both were crippled by the same defect, measured not assumed: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 has max_seq_length = 256 tokens. Median OCR page = 852 tokens; 98% of pages exceed the limit. The median page therefore lost ~70% of its text to silent truncation. OCR + MiniLM (manuscript: 25.24%) encoded each page's full OCR string in one call, so only the first 256 tokens of a 852-token page were ever seen. Fix: overlapping chunks, each encoded within the model's real context, page score = max over its chunks. VisionRAG Pyramid + RR
